answer: Cosignatures are collected in bridge, verified in meadow, and reef names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 40 submissions per epoch. The attacker spends 74 dollars and 6 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
